summary: Startup trace-log configuration. Checks the command-line arguments for the "notrace" flag via sub_587C20(a2, aNotrace); when the flag is absent, sets this[0] to 3000 and initializes the trace log with TraceLogInit(this); when the flag is present, skips initialization and returns the flag-check result. Called once from GameMainEntry (0045B200).

local_names.this: trace log configuration/state object whose first field holds the trace buffer setting
local_names.a2: command-line argument list handed to the flag check
local_names.result: flag-check result from sub_587C20 (non-zero when the flag is present)

operations.description: sub_587C20(a2, aNotrace) tests the command-line arguments for the flag string aNotrace ("notrace"); the return value is non-zero when the flag is present
When the flag check returns non-zero ("notrace" present), skip initialization and return that result early
When the flag is absent, write 3000 to this[0] as the trace buffer setting
TraceLogInit(this) initializes the trace log file using the configured object
Returns the TraceLogInit result on the initialization path, or the flag-check result when the flag is present
Invoked once from GameMainEntry (0045B200) at startup
